LESSON: SCULPTURE (TOY ASSEMBLAGE)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Performing and Display
Topic 2.3: Sculpture (Toy Assemblage)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sculpture (Toy Assemblage), part of Performing and Display in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: What local materials can be used to make a toy?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sculpture (Toy Assemblage) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner works together collect and sort different recyclable material assemblage of

toys or dolls.

• Creativity and imagination: The learner assemble the materials to get the structure of the doll or toy,

Values:
• Respect: The learner gives positive feedback as they display items made.

• Unity: The learner in groups, collect and sort different recyclable materials
